attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of tenant objects to update

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The display name of the tenant's company. Cannot be blank unless IsCompany is false.

attributes.name: IsCompany
attributes.description: Whether the tenant is a company (controls if the company name should be used as the name of the tenant). When true, CompanyName must be set. When false, FirstName and LastName must both be set.

attributes.name: MoveInOn
attributes.description: The date the tenant physically started or will start occupancy. Dictates whether the "future" or "current" option is displayed in the status field.

attributes.name: MoveOutOn
attributes.description: The date the tenant physically ended or will end occupancy. Dictates whether the "notice" or "past" option is displayed in the status field.

attributes.name: PrimaryTenant
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the tenant is the primary leaseholder for the occupancy. At least one PrimaryTenant is required per UnitId. Note: PrimaryTenant: true automatically sets the TenantType to Financially Responsible.

attributes.name: TenantType
attributes.description: The type of tenant. At least one tenant with TenantType Financially Responsible is required per UnitId.

attributes.name: Addresses
attributes.description: The tenant's address(es). Passing any number of addresses will replace all existing addresses for the tenant. Passing an empty array [] will remove all existing addresses for the tenant.

attributes.name: PhoneNumbers
attributes.description: The tenant's phone number(s). Passing any number of phone numbers will replace all existing phone numbers for the tenant. Passing an empty array [] will remove all existing phone numbers for the tenant.

attributes.name: Pets
attributes.description: Contains details about the tenant's pet(s). This will add new pets to the tenant and not remove any existing pets.

attributes.name: Vehicles
attributes.description: Contains details about the tenant's vehicle(s). This will add new vehicles to the tenant and not remove any existing vehicles.

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.description: The tenant's email address(es). Passing any number of emails will replace all existing email addresses for the tenant. Passing an empty array [] will remove all existing email addresses for the tenant.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the tenant. Providing an array of valid strings will overwrite all existing tags. Passing in an empty array [] or an array of empty strings [""] or ["", ""] will clear all existing tags. Passing in an array of a valid string and an empty string ["tag_name", ""] will result in Tags: ["tag_name"]. Passing in null will result in no change.

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bulk update job
